decisions.reason: The conferencing service remains a useful complement to managed communications and still meets enterprise demand.
Metro data centre connectivity is core to the firm's network strategy and has demonstrated adoption.
Optical spectrum connectivity supports high-bandwidth, software-defined infrastructure and is strategically important.
Carrier pre-selection is a legacy voice service with declining demand and limited strategic fit.
Direct voice network connections still serve enterprise voice requirements, but the firm will monitor migration to IP.
